items.title: Ignacio Berroa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 24, 2021 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: The interviewee addresses the interviewer as 'Monk' (Monk Rowe). There is no mention of the jazz composer Thelonious Monk, nor any personal interaction with him.

ctx.x: I’m very pleased to have Ignacio Berroa with me this morning, from Miami. And I’m in New York in Hamilton College and my name is Monk Rowe. Thanks a lot for joining me.
My pleasure, thank you for having me, Monk.
You know we, before our quote film was rolling, I think we have something in common in that Glenn Miller caught our ear in our youth. Is that correct?
